cohort: 100 patients with eclampsia, either antenatal or within 10 days after delivery, who were mostly nulliparous, aged 20-30 years, unbooked, and from a rural population.
finding: Maternal complications observed included cerebral oedema (6%), CVT (3%), pulmonary oedema (2%), deranged LFT (3%), nephropathy (3%), hypertensive retinopathy (12%), massive ascites (3%), abruptio placentae (1%), PPH (3%), and PRES (4%), with maternal mortality at 2% and perinatal mortality at 22.22%.
